title: Smart Supervision: Leveraging ELISTA to Strengthen Student Motivation and Thesis Completion
reason: Regression of self-reported motivation on Likert-rated perceptions of lecturer interaction in the ELISTA LMS. Activity logs are named as an instrument but never analysed; all quantitative variables are self-report.

extraction.n_quote: A total of 100 Physics Education students at Universitas Jambi participated as respondents in this study.
extraction.population: undergraduate physics education students in thesis supervision, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: none analysed (ELISTA activity logs mentioned only)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: motivation to complete the final project (self-report)
extraction.notes: R² = 0.236; β = 0.341 (clarity) and 0.268 (feedback) are perception-to-motivation paths, not LMS indicators. Inconsistency: ANOVA total df = 162 implies 163 cases, against 100 respondents stated.
